items.headline: SpaceX's stock wasn't the company's only launch today
items.teaser: Liftoff of the Falcon 9 rocket occurred at 8:27 a.m. ET, just over an hour before SpaceX went public on the NASDAQ stock market.

items.headline: Japan's H3 rocket bounces back from failure with successful return to flight launch carrying 6 satellites
items.teaser: Japan successfully completed its first mission with its H3 rocket since a launch failure last year resulted in the loss of a payload.

items.headline: Could the secret to black hole formation be locked away in this record-breaking ancient quasar?
items.teaser: The quasar existed 12.9 billion years ago and shows that supermassive black holes were able to age rapidly in the early universe.

items.headline: Why is the US Space Force researching 'orbital warehouses'?
items.teaser: As the US military readies for two 2027 missions to test spacecraft maneuvering, a new challenge with orbital warehouses aims to beef up space infrastructure.

items.headline: The Universe is Still Running Away From Us
items.teaser: Last year, a study sent a quiet tremor through the field of cosmology. A team of researchers claimed that the universe's expansion might be slowing down, not speeding up, suggesting that dark energy, the mysterious force thought to be driving the cosmos apart, could be weakening.
